title: Solar storm warning
description: MOCK EVENT. A strong solar storm will reach the spacecraft within hours.

options.label: Enter safe mode
options.effect_summary: Lose part of this period's science; protect the electronics.

options.label: Keep observing
options.effect_summary: Keep all the science; even odds of lasting damage.

title: Power bus fault
description: MOCK EVENT. A fault on the power bus is draining the battery. A thin power margin makes this more likely.

options.label: Switch off the instruments
options.effect_summary: Lose much of this period's science; no risk to the spacecraft.

options.label: Reset the power bus
options.effect_summary: Keep the science; some chance of permanent damage.
